C9000363.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 363 (Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation.; papers: Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation; Nonuniqueness for the periodic hard-sphere Boltzmann equation; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/363.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C3.statement: For every fixed nonaxial endpoint and arbitrary analytic axial partner profiles, the ordered three-gain history map has rank seven almost everywhere.

C3_ALG.statement: The actual recursive first variation at the ordered witness has determinant R*(t1-t3)*(R+1)*(R^2+1)>0, independently of all profile jets.

C3_ZERO.statement: A nontrivial analytic minor on the connected ordered domain has null zero set, which contains all rank failures.

C2.statement: Two redundant plane blocks supply independent kernel directions even when their normals vanish; the two-gain map has rank at most six everywhere.

C3_PULLBACK.statement: The three-gain limiting map supports uniform pullback along compact C1 perturbations with bounded densities, including spectator variables.

C5_SOURCE.statement: The manuscript recursion and analytic implicit profiles specialize the three-gain theorem; the existing five-gain proof does not assert optimality.

C5_RANK.statement: Appending zero witness planes after the third gain gives the same positive minor for every m>=3; in particular the actual five-gain manuscript map has a.e. rank seven for arbitrary analytic axial profiles.

NOVELTY_REVIEW.statement: Independent assessment establishes whether the sharp three-gain theorem is new and publishably significant; neither is inferred from exact algebra or a bounded search.

MAIN_PERIODIC.statement: September Theorem thm:main: one nonnegative periodic datum with bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, entropy has two distinct global admissible solutions, strongly L1 continuous on a common initial interval with integrable gains and losses there.

MAIN_LOCAL.statement: October Theorem thm:main: one nonnegative datum of bounded velocity support and finite mass, energy, entropy has two distinct global entropy solutions with local conservation, global strong L1 continuity, and locally time-integrable collision gains and losses with every polynomial velocity weight.

PDE_COLD.statement: Audit obligation for staged Proposition prop:cold-control, including all its estimates and hypotheses.

PDE_CAP.statement: Audit obligation for staged Proposition prop:finite-cap and cap separation.

PDE_LIMIT.statement: Audit obligations for staged Propositions prop:admissible-limits and prop:blowup-limit: compactness and admissibility of the required limits.

PDE_NONZERO.statement: Audit obligation for staged Proposition prop:nonzero-limit: nonvanishing hot mass in the limit.

PDE_BRANCH.statement: Audit obligation for staged Proposition prop:finite-dilated-horizon and the branching-to-global argument.

PDE_NONCONCENTRATION.statement: Audit obligation for vanishing of two axial gains and five nonaxial gains, including kernel truncations, weights, and cutoff removal; rank alone does not establish it.

PDE_LOCAL_CONSERVATION.statement: Audit obligation for October local conservation, collision-integrability and global strong L1 continuity, not supplied by the rank theorem.
